quotes.text: 1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?
2. ¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?
1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)
... no podía trabajar por razones personales? (cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad)

assessments.reasoning: The household questionnaire asks who performs most household tasks and who helps with household tasks (Block VII, Questions 1 and 2), and the individual questionnaire excludes household tasks from the definition of work (Question 1a) while recording care of the household as a reason for not working (Question 1e). Nowhere in the instrument is there a question asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for household members while doing other activities or without care being their main activity.
